value.rationale: This is a natural all-size complete classification of a finite frustrated magnetic network, with a sharp parity-dependent first critical field, exact critical multiplicities 3 versus exponentially many, and a nonzero odd-subsequence residual entropy ln(phi). It answers concrete finite-size magnetometry/entropy questions and reveals a qualitative parity boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a tiny numerical improvement; it neither asserts a bulk phase transition nor claims Fibonacci counting alone is novel.
